about: Bell to Bell's Blender style sheet as data (WISHLIST.md 'Blender assets' B1). validate.mjs reads it. Every file is glTF Separate: the .gltf and its .bin, which is what the pipeline writes and the meshopt recipe reads; once the recipe has run, the .glb beside it (the same name) is checked too, and is the only place EXT_meshopt_compression may appear. Every material is named for a palette entry and carries its colour: the game's PALETTE in src/world/materials.js, and the four colours of the Kenney furniture kit's desk, bookcases and chair. Bytes are the .gltf and .bin together, triangles x 128 + 8 KiB: a flat-shaded triangle carrying its own three vertices (position, normal and UV, 32 bytes each), three 16-bit indices and headroom, plus the JSON. extent is the longest side a class may have, in metres, a sanity bound only; each item's box is the one data/room.json (or src/world/) gives what it replaces, held to 10% per axis (x, y, z in three's frame). texture is the largest image side in pixels: a desk-top prop a hand could cover gets 512 at most (#621), a classroom prop 1024, the room's own sets' size, and an image is a loose file beside the .gltf, never embedded.
